title: The Old Furnace at Darby Ironworks, Coalbrookdale
lineage: Brief research notes; not a source copy.

passages.note: The aggregated heritage record describes the pre-existing 1638 charcoal furnace, Darby’s 1708 lease, nearby ironstone, and coke-fuel iron smelting in 1709. Waterwheel marks are archaeological observations but their exact period is not established. Avoid claiming 1709 volume, financial return or global first.
